legacy_cells.B: LLM-Integrated Bayesian State Space Models for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
legacy_cells.C: Sungjun Cho, Changho Shin, Suenggwan Jo, Xinya Yan, Shourjo Aditya Chaudhuri, Frederic Sala
legacy_cells.I: 044_2025_LLM-Integrated Bayesian State Space Models for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Forecast future daily heart-rate measurements and corresponding nursing-note text for hospitalized patients.
legacy_cells.T: 73 hospitalized patients; each patient's data spans an average of 104 days.
legacy_cells.X: F2 EHR / ICU event & latent patient dynamics
legacy_cells.AI: Daily numerical heart-rate measurements; nursing-note text (medical); daily temperature measurements; textual weather descriptions (climate)
legacy_cells.AJ: Single-layer GRU SSM; pretrained LLM text encoder/decoder; MLP posterior and numeric emission; linear projection of latent states to LLM prefix tokens
legacy_cells.AM: Text is compressed to summary tokens and projected to latent dimension; numeric value, summary, and prior state feed Gaussian posterior inference; shared latent state also conditions text generation.
legacy_cells.AT: Deep Kalman filtering: recurrent prior from previous state; Gaussian posterior conditioned on current value and text-summary vector; sample posterior state by reparameterization.
legacy_cells.BL: Daily observations; maximum forecast horizon 7 steps for climate and 6 steps for medical data.
legacy_cells.BS: Future numerical values and state-conditioned textual forecasts
legacy_cells.BT: Numeric-value MLP emission and LLM text-generation decoder conditioned on latent state
legacy_cells.BV: Negative multimodal ELBO: numeric-value likelihood, text likelihood, and KL temporal regularization; appendix weights value=1.0, KL=1.0, text=0.1.
legacy_cells.BY: Default LLM is LLaMA3.1-8B; tested LLM sizes range from Qwen2.5-0.5B to LLaMA3-8B.
legacy_cells.DQ: 73 patients (TTC-MEDICAL); average patient data length 104 days
legacy_cells.DX: TTC-MEDICAL test RMSE at H=1: LBS multimodal 3.583, LBS unimodal 3.910; TTC-CLIMATE: 4.117 and 4.224, respectively.
legacy_cells.DY: TTC-MEDICAL test RMSE at H=6: LBS multimodal 5.487, unimodal 5.654; TTC-CLIMATE at H=7: 6.133 and 6.473, respectively.
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with PatchTST, NLinear, NLinear-Text, TSFLib, TT2TT, and HybridMMF; LBS multimodal test RMSE is 3.583 at medical H=1 and 5.487 at H=6.
legacy_cells.EK: Compared LBS multimodal with unimodal LBS; also evaluated LLM scaling across LLaMA3 and Qwen2.5 sizes.
legacy_cells.EN: Broader impact notes risk that plausible LLM-generated forecasts may be misinterpreted as authoritative or factual and contribute to misinformation.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces LBS, integrating a probabilistic SSM and pretrained LLM for joint numerical/text forecasting, text-conditioned posterior estimation, and state-conditioned text generation.
legacy_cells.FN: On TTC, LBS improves best baseline performance by 5.13% on climate and 21.28% on medical on average; the paper also reports lower multimodal than unimodal RMSE.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors state that training uses single-step batches; multi-step training (e.g., backpropagation through time or latent overshooting) may improve performance but presents computational/DeepSpeed compatibility challenges; Mamba integration is future work.
legacy_cells.FP: Future work includes multi-step training strategies and integration with newer state-space architectures such as Mamba.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify the lack of integration between pretrained LLMs and probabilistic state-space models for joint numerical/text forecasting.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports retrospective forecasting of a medical time series, not action-conditioned treatment response, identified counterfactuals, or decision/control utility; reported clinical test data use a temporal split within one benchmark.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–15: title and abstract; introduction and related work; preliminaries and complete methods; experimental setup/results and figures; conclusions, limitations, and broader impact; appendices covering datasets, prompts, models, optimization, and full result tables. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: All extracted pages and tables were readable. This is a general multimodal forecasting method evaluated on a clinical time-series benchmark, not an intervention or clinical decision system. The PDF byline directly contradicts the prefilled author field, so column C is corrected; all other prefilled A:I fields are preserved. Evidence QA: 46/65 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (70.8%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 55 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 11 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.
